data.action: 双手合拢凝聚柔和的治愈水流，晨光穿过树梢
data.camera: cowboy shot, conjuring water sphere beside forest brook
data.description: 【希露菲 · 森林魔法练习】阳光穿透树冠洒在清幽的森林空地上，希露菲神情专注地合拢双手，无需咏唱便在指尖汇聚出一道柔和治愈的纯净水流。她转过身开心地向你展示——「看！无咏唱的治愈魔术我也越来越熟练了！以后只要有我在，就绝对不会让你受到任何伤害。」
data.promptProse: Sylphiette brings both hands together beside the forest brook, silently gathering a gentle healing stream between her palms. Green hooded cloak, white shirt, shorts and travelling boots retain the mage outfit beneath a focused expression. The cowboy view places the brook behind her hands and trunks receding through morning mist. Golden sunlight filters from the canopy, shining through the water and illuminating her fingers while cooler mist softens the farther trees.
data.title: 希露菲叶特 · 森林魔法练习
